planner.goal: If Tibo's next goal is to {{goal}}: is that the best thing now? Rank in this order. If health is under 25%, food or evading comes first. Otherwise: opening a chest first (free pick, and it evolves weapons), fighting an elite next (it drops a chest), then collecting nearby xp gems, then exploring for new chests. Do not evade just because many pests or a boss are around; the weapons handle them.
planner.pick: Tibo is at a {{choice}}. Which option makes Tibo strongest? Commit to one evolution line: level the weapon that has its catalyst passive held or on offer (Steam Vent with Root Network, Locked Gatling with Masher Grip) and take the catalyst when offered. Never take Reroll when a useful card is shown. Take Gravy Heart for max hp early. Keep damage passives (Butter Pat, Hot Sauce) next, and prefer armor and dodge items when offered.

action.hurt: If Tibo does this: {{move}}. How badly does it hurt Tibo in the next second?
action.useful: If Tibo does this: {{move}}. Does it bring Tibo closer to its goal ({{goal}})?
action.dash: Is Tibo about to be hit or surrounded, so a quick dash away would save it?

why: Plain chest-first is the base that lived 17:20 and 18:36 on Nightmare 1. It passed 3 of 3 fresh seeds in L3.I2 (7-9 chests, early evolutions), where the crowd exception (6:42) and the 200-unit boss exception (0 chests on 2 of 3 seeds) starved chests. The late-game boss problem is tested separately with the tight boss-100 text before any exception ships.
